passwordPrompt.title: Password required
passwordPrompt.hint: This lobby is password-protected. Enter the password to join.

createLobby.title: Create new lobby
createLobby.subtitle: Set match options and confirm.
createLobby.share_hint: After creating, open the lobby screen and share the Lobby ID so friends can join from their menu.
createLobby.target_help: No: match ends when time runs out or the host ends it. Yes: first team to reach the goal count below wins.
createLobby.ball_outline_help: Wraps the ball in yellow + red outline rings (any ball model). Easier to see during play.
createLobby.inventory_help: Allowed: players can open their inventory and draw weapons during the match. Locked: inventory is blocked and the player is forced to unarmed throughout the match.
createLobby.kickoff_touch_title: After each goal — who can touch the ball first?
createLobby.kickoff_touch_help: Standard: only the restart side can claim the ball first (kick-off lock). Free for all: both teams can touch the ball immediately (good for testing or casual play).
createLobby.err_target: With goal target on, enter at least 1 goal.
createLobby.err_format: Team sizes must be between 1 and 11.
createLobby.err_network: Could not reach the game menu. Try again.
createLobby.err_create_timeout: No response from server. Check notifications or try again.
createLobby.password_help: Leave empty to keep the lobby public. Up to 32 characters.
createLobby.spawn_after_goal_title: Spawn in own half after goal
createLobby.spawn_after_goal_help: Yes: players fade out and teleport to kickoff line-up positions on their own half after a goal. No: players stay where they are.
createLobby.time_left_help: Adjust remaining match time (capped at total match duration).

editLobby.title: Lobby settings
editLobby.subtitle: Update rules and duration during the match.
editLobby.err_timeout: No response from server. Try again.
editLobby.password_edit_help: Leave blank to keep the current password. Enter a new one to change it.
